title: [SOLVED] Anyone tracking Steam hours while using 2k3 with Maniacs patch?

posts.author: kn1000a
posts.body:
Hello,
For the current game jam I am picking up RPGM 2k3 from Steam and setting up maniacs patch.
Thing is, seems like the patch created a separate folder within the Steam's RPGM 2k3 folder. Inside this folder is the maniacs-patched 2k3 with no RTP (had to move the RTP folder from the Steam folder inside this new patched folder).
Of course, when I launch 2k3 from this patched folder, Steam doesn't recognize it.
So I wanna know if anybody is using maniacs but also managed to have Steam track your hours for 2k3.
Thanks!

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
If you run the steam version, then no matter how you start the software, it should still run trough steam.
If you want to be sure, you can open your project while steam isn't running. If it runs trough steam, it should not start.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: No, the RPG Maker is not connected to Steam, only installed by it but not integrated with it. If you run the RPG2003.exe directly, Steam doesn't know about it. This also goes the other way though: if you move the original RPG Maker 2003 to another folder and put the patched version in place of the original, you can start it through Steam and then Steam will track your time.
